name: Dusat aft-firing EMP emitter
description: The Dusat aft-firing EMP emitter was a model of electromagnetic pulse weapon which was mounted on the Joben T-85 speeder bikes made by Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation. The Jedi Kanan Jarrus disabled the EMP emitter on his T-85 bike when he used it on the planet Lothal.
